## Change

Explain the concrete problem and resulting behavior.

Role: A / B / C / D / shared governance
Related issue:

## Interfaces and documentation

List shared model, adapter, API, storage or security changes and affected roles.
Name updated documentation, or explain why none is needed.

## Validation

Record exact commands and outcomes. Separate passed, failed and not-run checks;
include missing prerequisites. For experimental results, include artifact hashes,
tool versions, configuration and limitations. No security claim follows from a
transformation count alone.

## Handoff

State remaining work, dependencies and the next concrete step.
